title: 第9章 前世恩怨第10章 前世未报今世十倍偿还
lines: “我靠，哥们你有点牛逼啊，观察力比电影里的侦探还牛逼！”
王冲吞了吞口水，赶紧求助：“那你觉得，我是去打篮球比较好，还是听爸妈去师范大学比较好？”
唐明问道：“要我说真话？”
王冲如小鸡啄米般点头：“当然，我现在特迷茫，哥们你帮我分析分析呗。”
“我的建议是，爱好终归是爱好，你不能让自己的爱好凌驾于生活之上。”
“国内大环境下，职业篮球队的发展并不出色，尤其是青训队。”
“很多人从小就进入青训队培训，你现在去已经迟了，青训队能不能熬出头还是个问题，就算熬得住，进入CBA打球也很困难。”
唐明停顿片刻，清清嗓子。
王冲赶紧掏出一瓶汽水，咧嘴笑道：“哥，你继续说。”
“谢谢，我不喝汽水……”
唐明拒绝汽水，继续分析：“你出生书香门第，长辈都是老师，所以走老师这条路算是事半功倍。”
“别觉得家长思想顽固，老一辈的人的经验比你强无数倍，未来谁也说不定，有个稳妥的生活也很好。”
“然后再说你的爱好，当了老师也可以继续打篮球，校园篮球队、社区篮球队、市区篮球队等等，都能满足你的爱好……”
听着唐明的话语。
王冲从先前的纠结难受，逐渐变得思路清晰。
“好像是这个道理。”
王冲挠挠脑袋，钦佩不已：“哥们，你太牛叉了，被你这么一说我似乎没那么纠结了，太感谢了，中午我请你吃饭。”
爱好是爱好，生活归生活，不能本末倒置。
唐明这番话，让他豁然开朗。
“不用客气。”
唐明笑着摇摇头，他其实还有句话没说。
王冲在二十岁的时候，会发现自己患有家族遗传性冠心病，并不适合打篮球。
而且扭伤脚筋后，因为瘸腿形象不佳，面试老师岗位也不断失败，最后心灰意冷，在一个小学当了个保安。
“中海附中，和我关系较好的，也就是苏雨柔和王冲两人了。”
“至于其他的……”
唐明突然抬头，看向教室前方的挂钟。
马上就到八点钟了。
“应该快来了吧？”
唐明嘴角噙着一抹冷意。
正说着，教室后门被人推开，五六名吊儿郎当的高个子涌进教室，为首一名寸头青年，打着耳钉，面色冷峻。
高三九班的许杰！
这人在附中很有名，因为他专门收取转校生的保护费，行事张狂跋扈，算得上校霸。
班上不少人看到许杰，面色微变。
王冲神色微变，赶紧起身赔笑：“杰哥，什么风把你吹过来了？”
“当然是正事。”
许杰大步走过来，来到唐明身前：“王冲，这就是你们班新来的转校生？”
王冲赔着笑，递过去一包香烟：“杰哥，他和我关系不错，保护费的事要不算了吧？”
“不行，规矩就是规矩，不能破。”
许杰敲了敲唐明的课桌：“小子，附中的规矩，外地转校生每人交五百元保护费，交了钱，能避免很多意外。”
光明正大的讹诈，就是这般嚣张。
唐明轻笑摇头：“若是不交呢？”
“你说什么？”
许杰眸光瞬间冰寒下来。
content_en:
"Damn, man, you are kind of awesome, your observation skills are better than the detectives in the movies!"
Wang Chong swallowed his saliva and hurriedly asked for help: "Then, do you think it would be better for me to play basketball, or would it be better for me to follow my parents and go to a normal university?"
Tang Ming asked: "You want me to tell the truth?"
Wang Chong nodded like a chicken pecking at rice: "Of course, I am very confused now. Brother, please help me analyze it."
"My advice is that hobbies are hobbies after all, and you can't let your hobbies take precedence over your life."
"Under the domestic environment, the development of professional basketball teams is not outstanding, especially youth training teams."
"Many people have been training in the youth training team since childhood. It's too late for you to go now. Whether the youth training team can survive is still a question. Even if it can survive, it will be very difficult to enter the CBA to play."
Tang Ming paused for a moment and cleared his throat.
Wang Chong quickly took out a bottle of soda, grinned and said, "Brother, keep talking."
"Thank you, I don't drink soda..."
Tang Ming refused the soda and continued his analysis: "You come from a scholarly family, and your elders are all teachers, so taking the teacher's path is a way to get twice the result with half the effort."
"Don't think your parents are stubborn. The experience of the older generation is countless times better than yours. No one can predict the future. It's good to have a stable life."
"Then let's talk about your hobbies. You can continue to play basketball when you become a teacher. Campus basketball teams, community basketball teams, urban basketball teams, etc. can all satisfy your hobbies..."
Listen to Tang Ming's words.
Wang Chong gradually became clearer from the previous confusion and discomfort.
"That seems to be the truth."
Wang Chong scratched his head and was filled with admiration: "Brother, you are so awesome. After you said that, I seem to be less entangled. Thank you so much. I will treat you to dinner at noon."
Hobbies are hobbies, and life is life. You can’t put the cart before the horse.
Tang Ming's words made him suddenly enlightened.
"You're welcome."
Tang Ming smiled and shook his head. He actually had nothing to say.
When Wang Chong was twenty years old, he would discover that he had a family hereditary coronary heart disease and was not suitable for playing basketball.
Moreover, after I sprained my hamstring, I kept failing interviews for teacher positions because of my poor image due to my lameness. Finally, I became discouraged and became a security guard in a primary school.
"The people I have a good relationship with at Zhonghai Affiliated High School are Su Yurou and Wang Chong."
"As for the rest..."
Tang Ming suddenly raised his head and looked at the wall clock in front of the classroom.
It's almost eight o'clock.
"Should it be coming soon?"
There was a hint of coldness in the corner of Tang Ming's mouth.
Just as he was talking, the back door of the classroom was pushed open, and five or six tall and careless men rushed into the classroom, led by a short-haired young man with earrings and a stern expression.
Xu Jie from Class 9, Grade 3!
This man is very famous in the attached high school because he specializes in collecting protection fees from transfer students, acts arrogantly and domineeringly, and is considered a bully in the school.
Many people in the class saw Xu Jie and their expressions changed slightly.
Wang Chong's expression changed slightly, and he quickly stood up to apologize: "Brother Jie, what brought you here?"
"Of course it's business."
Xu Jie strode over and came to Tang Ming: "Wang Chong, is this the new transfer student in your class?"
Wang Chong smiled apologetically and handed over a pack of cigarettes: "Brother Jie, he and I have a good relationship. Should we forget about the protection fee?"
"No, the rules are the rules, they can't be broken."
Xu Jie knocked on Tang Ming's desk: "Boy, the rules of the attached middle school are that each out-of-town transfer student pays a protection fee of 500 yuan. If you pay, you can avoid many accidents."
Justifiable blackmail is so arrogant.
Tang Ming chuckled and shook his head: "What if we don't hand over?"
"What did you say?"
Xu Jie's eyes turned cold instantly.
title_en: Chapter 9: Grudges from past lives Chapter 10: Repay ten times what was not repaid in this life
